A meat dish shaped like a rose is placed on the table, followed by a large platter of thinly sliced raw beef. Dessert items including small glass jars of clear soup and a container of green-labeled ice cream are shown. The video ends with the mother talking directly to the camera while wearing the restaurant bib, followed by a quick shot of the creator giving a thumbs-up.
